items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: There was also another attraction with us, a comedian named Jean Raymond.

ctx.x: Back in France, I was engaged in July for a tour with a fashion show for four weeks with a group of four dishy girls who were models. The show played in casinos all over France. We even went to Tunisia for four days and gave a show in front of the son of President Bourguiba. The fasion show was going on for an hour, than I played a half hour. I had my pianist, Gabriel Garvanoff, a fine young musician with me, but we had to play with the bass and drummer from the casinos. There was also another attraction with us,…

We did 10,000 miles with our car in four weeks, not counting the trip to Tunisia. The atmosphere was gay and if it was quite tiresome to do all this travelling, we had a lot of fun anyway. And the food in France is superb.
